text:
nina: trying the "starter-stub" quickstart after accepting the org invite + SSO. UI shows a terse 'Request failed (403)' toast with no link. first call blocked, can't tell why.

nina: client console shows `{"code":"workspace_billing_required","detail":"billing not attached"}` but the sample app doesn't surface that.

onboard-bot: Hey @nina — new workspaces require billing before using hosted endpoints. Add a payment method: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/zz9/billing :credit_card:

lee: can you share whether you used the browser OAuth flow or a local service key?

nina: browser OAuth (Okta). I followed the wizard in order: invite -> accept -> ToS. We later attached billing, but the timing was awkward and the initial run already failed.

rachel: hmm this is the "invisible gating" problem again. The client should map the backend error code to a clear modal with a link and steps. Quickstarts are our first impression for new users.

lee: temporary workaround: start the quickstart with a service key so the call bypasses workspace gating: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_...` then run the dev server.

lee: curl example that works with a service key:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```

nina: confirmed that trick works locally. but we should fix the browser path. new users won't know to open the console.

rachel: proposal: quickstart client should detect `workspace_billing_required` and show a persistent banner with: 1) clear copy that billing is required, 2) a button that opens the workspace billing page in a new tab, 3) a note about SSO invite timing (if invite accepted before billing attach).

rachel: I'll draft a tiny PR to the starter repo that adds an error-to-ui map and a friendly banner. ETA tomorrow.

lee: on the API side we can help by adding `x-redwood-why: billing_required` in the 403 response and emitting telemetry event `onboard_missing_billing` so DX teams can track frequency. filing infra ticket.

infra-bot: ticket INF-412 created: "add x-redwood-why header for billing-required 403s" assigned to @lee.

nina: also ask product to add a line in the onboarding guide: "If you accept an SSO invite before a billing method is attached, you may see a 403 on first requests — add billing to your workspace or use a service API key for local testing."

rachel: will update quickstart README and add a one-liner to /docs/onboarding.

lee: leaving a short note for support: sample app telemetry should include the raw error code so we can ask customers to paste it in tickets.

nina: thanks all. reopening this thread if anything else shows up during QA after PR lands.
